errors.text_span: с линейна скала, разположена от 0 до 100 с интервали от 10
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible horizontal axis with a scale, ticks, or intervals. The description hallucinates these features.

errors.text_span: За всяка възрастова група са представени четири стълба, групирани хоризонтално
errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, with one bar per category divided into four segments. It is not a grouped bar chart with four separate bars per category.

errors.text_span: подредени в низходящ ред според възрастта
errors.evidence: The age groups on the vertical axis are arranged from youngest (top) to oldest (bottom), which is ascending order of age, not descending.
The color corresponding to the category „Изобщо не са уязвими“ is a very light grey or light blue, not white.

errors.text_span: Върху всеки стълб е поставена конкретна числовата стойност в проценти.
errors.evidence: The numerical values are placed on each segment of the stacked bars, not on each bar as a whole. This is a consequence of misinterpreting the chart as grouped instead of stacked.
